sections.name: AboutHero
sections.note: No interactive elements; heading word reveals use entrance curve that's applied uniformly across all content.

sections.name: AboutStory
sections.note: Sticky column and image are passive; parallax and reveals follow stock patterns with no interaction states.

sections.name: AboutTiles
sections.note: Alternating parallax strengths are compositional, not interactive; images are purely passive reveal targets.

sections.name: BookingSection
sections.note: Contact links have color-only hover with no press/focus distinction; form lacks any affordance feedback on interaction.

sections.name: DualBrandSplit
sections.note: Both panels enter identically with no stagger; arrow nudge is stock idiom, motion does not differentiate the two moods.

sections.name: Hero
sections.note: MagneticButton states underdeveloped—hover and active are not visibly distinct in code

sections.name: ServiceTicker
sections.note: Motion signature is stock marquee (no custom easing); choreography absent—both tracks enter simultaneously, continuous scroll

sections.name: Manifesto
sections.note: No interactive elements; section is passive reveal with horizontal drift—engagement is missing

sections.name: FinalCTA
sections.note: Staircase indentation is visual only; heading lacks delay, links have only color-swap hover

sections.name: EventIndex
sections.note: Layout changed from boxes to numbered list per comment; choreography absent—all items enter at once

sections.name: ServicesBento
sections.note: Scale-105 image zoom and accent-icon fade are stock idioms; hover-only state change; stagger pattern (i % 3) chunks entries but creates no motion hierarchy.

sections.name: ServicesHero
sections.note: KineticHeading and Marquee components defer motion implementation opaquely; pauseOnHover is the only visible interaction; no focus or active states.

sections.name: ServicesLedger
sections.note: Sticky column + scrolling ledger is a template pattern; service label color-on-hover is the only interaction; uniform stagger provides no motion hierarchy.

sections.name: SocietyCTA
sections.note: MagneticButton motion is opaque; contact links are color-on-hover only; intentional restraint is a design choice but does not carry a specific brand voice.

sections.name: SocietyCategories
sections.note: Hairline scale-x-100 on hover is content-specific but applies generic ease-out curve; hover-only interaction; loose stagger is clean but not orchestrated.

sections.name: SocietyGallery
sections.note: Asymmetric parallax gallery is a stock pattern; lacks interactive states and motion vocabulary distinctive to the mood.

sections.name: SocietyHero
sections.note: Restraint in not drifting the heading correctly expresses Society's voice, but quick animation timing and missing interactive states obscure the intention.

sections.name: SocietyStatement
sections.note: Indent progression and 0.35s pause before tagline create felt rhythm; restraint on heading drift is deliberate, but no interactive states.
